text:
Jordan C.: ping — LangChain + LlamaIndex asked if we can bundle their connectors + our Gateway + an orchestration quickstart as a single marketplace package. They want a 30-min sandbox demo and a one-pager install. cc @Priya @Nikhil

Priya R.: sounds good. GTM prefers one bundle SKU with optional professional services. Marketing wants copy + a short FAQ. Need recommended infra guidance for SI-managed clusters.

Nikhil (Eng): tech checklist: OIDC SP-initiated SSO (groups + email_verified), webhook callback with HMAC-SHA256, connector registration API, and a sample retry/backoff for orchestration. I'll draft a minimal quickstart and smoke-test script.

Jordan C.: partner asks for a sample `permissions.json` mapping connector roles to our console roles and a small docker-compose for local sandbox.

Nikhil (Eng): docker-compose idea:
```
version: '3'
services:
  gateway:
    image: redwood/gateway:staging
    environment:
      REDWOOD_TENANT=partner-sandbox
      BUNDLE_ID=tooling-bundle-2024
      WEBHOOK_SECRET=changeme
    ports: ["8080:8080"]
```
and curl to register connector:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/api/v1/connectors \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"langchain-connector","callback":"https://lc.example.com/cb"}'
```

Priya R.: timeline: partner wants sandbox Tues next week; marketing needs assets Mon. Can engineering deliver quickstart + permission manifest by EOD Fri?

Nikhil (Eng): yes. I'll include a HMAC node snippet and a malformed-callback test in the smoke-test so partners see failure modes.

Elena (GTM): also include a short blurb about performance: recommend 2xA10 for demo, 4xA10 for pilot; fallback CPU-only note. Marketing will adapt copy from that.

infra-bot: deploy-checker: staging tenant `partner-sandbox` created and bundle tag applied at 2024-06-14T09:18:02Z.

Jordan C.: perfect — deliverables: Nikhil -> quickstart PR (compose, curl, node HMAC, smoke-test), Priya -> marketplace blurb + FAQ, Elena -> scheduling + promo. I'll coordinate partner runthrough once PR merges. :thumbsup:
